name: Casa Mision Cristiana Monte de Sion
notes: Listed as an OC Food Bank (CAPOC) distribution partner but no specific recurring day/time published; CAPOC page says sites operate independently with varying hours (call 211). Not in City of Buena Park published list.

name: Centro Familiar Christiano Missionero
notes: CAPOC distribution partner (6870 Naomi Ave) but no specific recurring schedule found. Not in City of Buena Park published list.

name: Guidestone Church (First Church of the Nazarene)
notes: Runs 'JoAnn's Food Room' walk-in pantry + delivery on the Buena Park campus, but it is by-appointment: guidestone.church/foodbank says a volunteer schedules a time. No fixed recurring day/time published. Church open Mon-Fri 8am-5pm generally.

name: Holy Ground Christian Fellowship dba The Source Christian Center
notes: No credible food distribution schedule found under this name/address (7699 9th St #106, Buena Park).

name: Iglesia Bautista Vida Eterna
notes: Listed as CAPOC/OC Food Bank distribution partner (5722 Crescent Ave) but no specific recurring day/time published.

name: Son Ministry
notes: CAPOC distribution partner (6800 Orangethorpe Ave), primarily a missions nonprofit; no specific food-distribution schedule found.

name: Crossroads Multinational Church of the Nazarene
notes: Free groceries every Sunday 8:30-9:30 AM, no requirements. Consistent across multiple food-bank guides (Cerritos College CalWORKs guide, LA Best Babies guide). Source documents date to 2021 so confidence lowered; recommend confirming at (562) 809-4143 / 505-1154.

name: Costa Mesa Spanish DBA of SDA
notes: Costa Mesa Spanish Seventh-day Adventist Church (617 Hamilton St) is an OC Food Bank distribution partner and appears on Feed America as a food pantry, but no specific recurring day/time could be confirmed (Feed America listing returned a DB error). Church services Sat 9:45/11am are worship, not food distribution.

name: Friends of Families
notes: Cypress nonprofit + CAPOC partner. Their website (friendsoffamilies.net) publishes distributions via a rotating 'Distribution Flyer' (next date/location) rather than a fixed recurring weekly day/time, so no stable schedule to report.

name: Northeast of the Well
notes: northeastofthewell.org 'What We Do' lists Bible study, discipleship, anti-trafficking, and job-readiness programs; no food pantry / food distribution program is offered. The 2nd & 4th Saturday 8:30am item is a women's discipleship group, not food.
